question: The average runs scored by a batsman in 23 matches is 41. In the next 10 matches, the batsman scored an average of 15 runs. Find his average runs scored (rounded off to two decimal places) in all the 33 matches.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the assumed overall average be 41 runs.

Deviation of the next 10 matches from assumed average = 10 × (15 − 41) = −260

Net effect on the overall average = −260 ÷ (23 + 10) = −260 ÷ 33 ≈ −7.88

Overall average = 41 − 7.88 = 33.12

**∴ The correct answer is 33.12 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average runs in the first 23 matches = 41

Average runs in the next 10 matches = 15

**Formula Used:**

Overall Average = Total Runs ÷ Total Matches
